# Delulu Social

> A comprehensive social media management platform that enables users to create, schedule, and publish content across multiple social networks from a single dashboard.

Delulu Social streamlines social media management by allowing creators, businesses, and teams to post content simultaneously across Facebook, Instagram, Twitter/X, LinkedIn, TikTok, Pinterest, Threads, and Farcaster. The platform features real-time collaboration, intelligent scheduling, media management, and multi-account support.

## Platform Overview

- [Home](https://delulu.social): Platform introduction and key features
- [Pricing](https://delulu.social/pricing): Subscription tiers from Free to Pro with detailed feature breakdowns
- [Contact](https://delulu.social/contact): Get in touch with the Delulu team

## Key Features

**Multi-Platform Posting**: Create content once and publish across 8+ social media platforms including Facebook, Instagram, Twitter/X, LinkedIn, TikTok, Pinterest, Threads, and Farcaster.

**Content Scheduling**: Plan and schedule posts in advance with calendar view, timezone support, and optimal posting time recommendations.

**Media Management**: Upload and manage images, videos, and other media types with cloud storage integration and automatic format optimization.

**Team Collaboration**: Real-time collaboration features powered by LiveBlocks enable teams to work together on content creation and approval workflows.

**Account Management**: Connect and manage multiple social media accounts per platform with secure OAuth authentication.

## Supported Platforms

- **Facebook** (📘): Pages and personal profiles
- **Instagram** (📷): Feed posts, stories, and reels
- **Twitter/X** (🐦): Tweets and threads
- **LinkedIn** (💼): Personal and company posts
- **TikTok** (🎵): Video content publishing
- **Pinterest** (📌): Pins and boards
- **Threads** (🧵): Meta's text-based platform
- **Farcaster** (🏰): Decentralized social protocol

## Technology Stack

**Frontend**: Next.js 15 with React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Radix UI components

**Backend**: Prisma ORM with PostgreSQL, tRPC for type-safe APIs, Convex for real-time data

**Authentication**: Clerk for user management with OAuth integrations for social platforms

**Infrastructure**: Cloudflare Pages and Workers, AWS S3 for media storage, Stripe for payments

**Developer Tools**: Turbo monorepo, Biome for linting, Vitest for testing, Storybook for component development

## Pricing Tiers

**Free**: Basic features for individual users testing the platform

**Starter**: $9/month - Ideal for solo creators with multiple accounts

**Creator**: $29/month - For professional content creators with advanced scheduling

**Pro**: $79/month - Complete solution for teams and agencies with collaboration features
